t0399-01.gloss: Field residue and response material share one ambiguous bundle.
t0399-01.rival_reading: Field workers and emergency responders could each have made this mixed bundle; it does not settle which activity came first.

t0399-02.gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
t0399-02.rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
